description: Laying out and maintaining micro-irrigation drip and sprinkler networks, backwashing screen/disc filtration units, operating tractor PTO agricultural implements, and dosing fertilizers.
daily_tasks: Laying 16mm LLDPE lateral drip tubing along crop rows
Punching holes and fitting online pressure-compensating button emitters
Monitoring borewell submersible pump pressure gauges and starter panels
Backwashing and cleaning disc and screen irrigation filter elements
Calibrating venturi injector suction valves for liquid fertigation dosing
Hitching rotavators, disc harrows, and cultivators to tractor 3-point linkages
Connecting and safety-locking tractor Power Take-Off (PTO) shafts
advanced_tasks: Flushing clogged drip lines with diluted hydrochloric or phosphoric acid solutions
Troubleshooting pressure drop discrepancies across multi-hectare drip sub-mains
Calibrating micro-sprinkler throw diameters for orchard frost and heat protection
Overhauling submersible pump non-return foot valves and impellers
materials: PVC control ball valves & air release valves
work_processes: Head Control Unit Setup -> Mainline Laying -> Submain Installation -> Lateral Rolling -> Emitter Punching -> System Flushing -> Fertigation Injection -> Periodic Maintenance
troubleshooting_tasks: Detecting and clearing mineral carbonate scale clogs inside inline drippers
Rectifying vacuum lock or lack of suction in venturi fertilizer dosing manifolds
Tracing pressure loss caused by burst lateral lines or animal damage
Diagnosing single-phasing or low-voltage motor starter trip conditions
quality_inspection: Verifying uniform water discharge rate across both proximal and distal ends of laterals
Ensuring operating pressure at the end of the lateral remains within 1.0–1.2 bar
Confirming zero water leakage at grommet takeoff connections on PVC submains
Checking tight locking of tractor PTO safety shield chains
measurement_and_planning: Calculating crop water requirement based on daily pan evaporation and crop stage
Calculating fertigation dilution rates (kg fertilizer per 1,000 liters water)
safety_practices: Ensuring tractor PTO master safety guard is securely latched before engaging drive
Wearing chemical-resistant nitrile gloves and eye goggles when mixing liquid fertilizer/acid
Zero contact with live electrical starter terminals in damp agricultural pump sheds
Relieving pressurized irrigation lines before unscrewing filter casings
maintenance: Flushing lateral drip lines monthly by removing end caps
Lubricating tractor implement grease nipples daily with lithium grease
Cleaning suction foot valve strainers free of pond and well weeds
customer_communication: Explaining water savings (40–60%) of micro-irrigation to smallholder farmers
Advising on crop-specific emitter spacing (e.g. 30cm for vegetables, 1m for orchards)
Instructing farm helpers on daily filter backwash sequences
canonical_skills: Irrigation Disc Filter Flushing and Cleaning
Agricultural Pump Priming and Valve Regulation
